newsitem.title: EGYPT: Train kills seven people, injures two in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Train kills seven people, injures two in Egypt.

text.p: Seven people were killed and two others seriously injured on Tuesday after a train ran them over while they were crossing the tracks at a station north of Cairo, security sources said.
They told Reuters the commuters got off a train at Banha station, 40 km (25 miles) from Cairo, to catch another train which had stopped further up the tracks.
"They did not notice that a third train was rushing from the other direction and it ran over them,"one of the sources said.
The nine people were on their way to work in Cairo, the sources added.
